ABOUT AIR RAID 1: REOVERCHARGE
Air Raid 1: ReOvercharge is a remake/soft reboot of the Air Raid series, featuring a new story and characters. Join Jacob and his Watermelon Cannon on an adventure against robots to save his home and uncover the secrets of a mysterious energy called "Overcharge."
Coming Soon 28/04/2027

VA of Voice: Lizzie (@lizue on discord) 
https://www.youtube.com/@lizziewashere

VA of Operator/Walkie Talkie: Hex Walden
https://www.youtube.com/@hexmenot
